data.name: SKY DRIFT
data.detailed_description:
Take Flight in a World That Doesn’t Behave

Pilot a fragile, unpredictable rocket through a vibrant oversized alien world where every movement matters and nothing stays under control for long.

In Sky Drift, flying isn’t just movement — it’s a challenge. Your rocket struggles, drifts, and fights back, turning every moment into a balance between control and chaos.

A Journey Driven by Instability

The more you explore, the stranger things become.

Collecting too much energy doesn’t just help you progress… it breaks reality.
Unstable wormholes begin to appear, pulling you into unexpected places and pushing you deeper into a world you don’t fully understand.

Build, Move, Adapt

Your rocket isn’t just for flying.

Use its magnetic ability to:

  • Move objects

  • Build paths

  • Solve environmental puzzles

  • Unlock new areas

Every obstacle is a problem — and your tools are the solution.

A Giant World from a Tiny Perspective

Everything around you is massive.

Towering plants, oversized structures, and strange environments turn exploration into a constant sense of wonder. What looks simple from afar becomes a challenge up close.

Key Features

  • 🚀 Unstable Physics-Based Flight
    Master a rocket that doesn’t fully obey you

  • 🌍 Oversized Alien World
    Explore environments where scale changes everything

  • 🌌 Unpredictable Wormholes
    Your actions create chaotic transitions between areas

  • 🧲 Magnet-Driven Gameplay
    Interact with the world to solve puzzles and progress

  • 🎯 Lite-Action Experience
    Accessible, expressive gameplay focused on movement and exploration

Why You’ll Keep Playing

Every flight improves your control.
Every mistake teaches you something.
Every wormhole pulls you deeper.

You’re not just exploring the world…
You’re learning how to survive it.

Wishlist now and prepare to lose control.

data.short_description: Cute but challenging roguelite platformer-inspired game where you fly through a strange oversized world with a broken rocket and limited fuel. Avoid deadly obstacles, collect gems, and upgrade after every crash. No checkpoints. Start over and fly further.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Swedish, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
